rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a greenish-blue colour.

example.english: That shirt is aqua, so it feels refreshing to wear in summer.
example.traditional: 件衫係青綠色，夏天着好清爽。
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 hai6 ceng1 luk6 sik1 haa6 tin1 zoek3 hou2 cing1 song2

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the colour lies between blue and green.

example.english: The logo uses aqua to convey a feeling of the ocean and nature.
example.traditional: 個標誌用藍綠色，清楚表達海洋同大自然嘅感覺。
example.jyutping: go3 biu1 zi3 jung6 laam4 luk6 sik1 cing1 co2 biu2 daat6 hoi2 joeng4 tung4 daai6 zi6 jin4 ge3 gam2 gok3

rows.note: Use this for a lighter, bluer aqua shade, especially in descriptions of products or designs.

example.english: This phone case comes in aqua, and it looks great in photos.
example.traditional: 呢款手機殼有水藍色，影相時好襯。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 sau2 gei1 hok3 jau5 seoi2 laam4 sik1 jing2 soeng2 si4 hou2 can3
